name: review-workspace-monorepo
description: A local-first review workspace for coding-agent worktrees

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @review-workspace/schema build && pnpm --filter @review-workspace/adapter-api build && pnpm --filter @review-workspace/web build && pnpm --filter @review-workspace/host build
scripts.//pretest: Host tests import runtime values from the library packages, which resolve to dist. Building them first keeps `pnpm test` working on a fresh clone.
